scorecard.testEvidence: Scenario E: Previous academic year balance priority: 1. Previous Year Outstanding, 2. Current Year, 3. Oldest Month, 4. Oldest Item.

scorecard.testEvidence: Scenario G: Payment reversal: Original payment historically preserved with status VOID; allocations reversed; bill balance restored; immutable audit log recorded.
scorecard.notes: Verified against live Firestore transaction reversal with status VOID.

scorecard.testEvidence: Scenario H: Return/refund: Gross Cash Tendered (10,000) === Applied (9,600) + Returned (400) + Advance (0). Zero double-counting.
scorecard.notes: Equation verified: Gross 10000 === 9600 + 400 + 0

scorecard.testEvidence: Document Numbering Engine: Verified sequential, unique, formatted numbers for RMT, RCP, ADV, REF, REV without gaps or resets.
scorecard.notes: Allocated 3 consecutive numbers for all 5 financial doc types with atomic runTransaction in 2083 BS.

scorecard.testEvidence: Concurrent Document Allocation: 8 simultaneous workers allocated RCP numbers. Unique count: 8/8. Zero collisions.
Idempotency Protection: Re-submission of identical transaction ID detected existing record and prevented duplicate ledger entry.
scorecard.notes: Transaction ID TX_IDEMP_TEST_1789826582862 idempotency verified.

scorecard.testEvidence: Active Transactions Integrity Scan (2 documents): Checked for negative amounts and invalid receipts.
scorecard.notes: Scanned 2 active transactions. Negative amounts: false, Invalid receipts: false

scorecard.testEvidence: Student Advances Integrity Scan (20 documents): Checked for negative advance credit balances.
scorecard.notes: Scanned 20 advance documents. Negative advances: false

scorecard.testEvidence: Firestore Security Rules: Admin is sole financial writer; Teachers strictly blocked (!isTeacher()); Students read-only own records (isStudentOwner).
scorecard.notes: Rule invariants verified: remitBills write: isAdmin(); teacher fee read: blocked; student owner: enforced.

scorecard.testEvidence: API Security: eSewa HMAC-SHA256 signature generated correctly server-side; malformed birthday payload rejected with HTTP 400.
scorecard.notes: eSewa signature valid: true, Malformed rejected: true

scorecard.testEvidence: Endpoint /api/users/delete-auth lacks explicit Bearer token authorization middleware.
scorecard.notes: Finding: /api/users/delete-auth can be invoked without Authorization header. Note: Firebase Admin falls back to bypass when credentials lack IAM deleteUser, but token validation middleware must be added for production.

scorecard.testEvidence: Financial Input Sanitization: Evaluated 13 numeric/dirty inputs against sanitizeDigitsOnly and parseIntegerAmount. All output non-negative finite integers.
scorecard.notes: No NaN, Infinity, or negative amounts produced under malicious inputs.

scorecard.testEvidence: Nepali 12-Month Calendar: Canonical 12 BS months defined and normalized across billing periods.
scorecard.notes: Defined months: Baisakh, Jestha, Ashadh, Shrawan, Bhadra, Ashwin, Kartik, Mangsir, Poush, Magh, Falgun, Chaitra

scorecard.testEvidence: Audit Logs Immutability: Verified 9 existing audit log records. Schema contains required WHO, WHAT, WHEN fields.
scorecard.notes: Audit logs count: 9. Zero hard deletions allowed by security rules.

scorecard.testEvidence: Secret Leakage Inspection: Checked repository root for serviceAccountKey.json or private credentials.
scorecard.notes: Zero GCP service account JSON files or private keys stored in client-accessible directory.

scorecard.testEvidence: Environment Variable Naming: VITE_ESEWA_SECRET_KEY and VITE_KHALTI_SECRET_KEY have VITE_ prefix, which exposes variables to client builds if referenced.
scorecard.notes: Finding: Secret keys must be stripped of VITE_ prefix and accessed strictly server-side in server.ts.

scorecard.testEvidence: npm audit scan identified 51 vulnerabilities (2 critical, 20 high, 24 moderate, 5 low). Major items: SheetJS xlsx prototype pollution/ReDoS, websocket-driver, ws.
scorecard.notes: Finding: xlsx library has known vulnerabilities (CWE-1321, CWE-1333). Recommended remediation: replace with exceljs (already in package.json) or upgrade when upstream patches release.

scorecard.testEvidence: SEC-01: Unauthenticated read/write to financial collections
scorecard.notes: Blocked by isSignedIn() & isAdmin() rules.

scorecard.testEvidence: SEC-02: Student reads another Student private financial data
scorecard.notes: Blocked by isStudentOwner(studentId) check.

scorecard.testEvidence: SEC-03: Student navigates to Admin route in UI
scorecard.notes: Client router redirects to student dashboard or login.

scorecard.testEvidence: SEC-04: Student attempts direct Firestore write to remitBills

scorecard.testEvidence: SEC-05: Student attempts write to own financial records

scorecard.notes: Blocked: allow write: if isAdmin(); strictly enforced.

scorecard.testEvidence: SEC-07: Teacher attempts read of remitBills collection
